movie.title: Clash of the Thundermans
movie.overview: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When Chloe's dangerous new power threatens to tear the family apart, the Thundermans split into opposing factions and clash over her future.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After Chloe manifests a destructive power, the Hero League demands she be sent to a specialized boarding school. Unwilling to part with her, Phoebe, Barb, and Billy take Chloe into hiding, causing a rift within the household. Max, Hank, and Nora set out to track down the rogues, ultimately leading to an intense sibling-versus-sibling showdown.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Life for the Thunderman family takes a dramatic turn when youngest sibling Chloe develops a terrifying, uncontrolled superpower that poses a major threat. Fearing the dangerous potential of her abilities, the Hero League steps in and mandates that Chloe be enrolled at an elite hero boarding school, which would keep her away from home for years. Refusing to allow the family to be separated, Phoebe teams up with Barb and Billy to take Chloe off the grid and hide her from authority. However, Max, Hank, and Nora believe following Hero League protocol is the safest choice, creating a deep moral divide. As the hunting group tracks the fugitives across various locations, tensions rise and loyalties are tested. The pursuit culminates in a full-scale superpower battle between the two family factions. Ultimately, the confrontation forces everyone to reassess what being a hero—and a family—really means as they fight to secure Chloe's future on their own terms.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Thundermans face their greatest internal crisis yet when young Chloe develops an uncontrollable, destructive new ability. After the Hero League orders her immediate placement in a remote superhero academy to tame her powers, the family fractures over how to handle the situation. A rescue party led by Phoebe takes Chloe into hiding, while Max leads the effort to bring them back into compliance, setting the stage for an explosive confrontation that will determine the fate of the entire family.

story_structure.climax: The two family factions confront one another in an intense, full-on battle to determine Chloe's fate and the future of the Thunderman family.
story_structure.conflict: The Hero League orders Chloe to an elite superhero boarding school, forcing the family to choose between following authority or keeping their young family member at home.
story_structure.resolution: The clash forces the family to resolve their internal ideological rift and find a path forward regarding Chloe's powers and their unity.
story_structure.introduction: The Thunderman family faces a new crisis when Chloe develops a destructive superpower, drawing the immediate attention and intervention of the Hero League.
story_structure.risingAction: The Thundermans split into opposing factions as Phoebe, Barb, and Billy take Chloe into hiding, while Max, Hank, and Nora hunt down their rogue relatives.
